text: When everything falls apart, welcome the new. In moments of life when plans, hopes, or familiar structures collapse, people usually declare a "holy war" on the process of change, trying to hold on to familiar forms. Sometimes this succeeds (it happens that, indeed, one needs to learn to defend "what is one's own"). However, it often happens that as a result of the struggle things only get worse, and people go through the entire process of their rebirth in agony. Yet one can relax, and transformation will happen faster. Try immediately to consciously replace your fear that pushes you to struggle with a feeling of exciting liberation and anticipation of the new. Say to the Universe: “Thank you for removing what no longer corresponds to me, even if I myself am clinging to it.” Trust the wisdom of Life, including the wisdom of transformation. Accept what is happening as a snake changing its skin, and move in the flow.
